_meta.description: Heart event #1 for npc_kaydee: The Banter Test

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Well, well. Engineer's back. Starting to think you like my company.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Or maybe it's the ale. Hard to tell with you.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: HA! Not bad, engineer. Not bad at all.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: Most people can't keep up. They hear the sharp tongue and run.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: You just... sat back down and ordered another round.

lines.speaker: npc_kaydee
lines.text: I respect that. Don't let it go to your head.
